//2: baseline — profiles only decide which assets are COPIED into a target project. An asset
//3: that appears in no profile still lives in .github_general and is still linted; it just
//4: isn't pushed into projects that have no use for it. Add new project types by adding a
//6: Patterns are baseline-relative, forward-slash, case-insensitive. '**' matches any depth,
//10: '.github/**' in alwaysExcluded is THIS repo's own CI, not content for target projects. It runs tools/lint-baseline.ps1, and tools/ is itself excluded - so copying it would hand every project a workflow that fails on its first run.
//11: README.md is this repository's front page, written for someone deciding whether to adopt the baseline. Copied into a project it became .github/README.md, which GitHub shows INSTEAD of the project's own README, and /setup reads it as the project's description. Hence alwaysExcluded.
//12: retired: files the baseline used to write into projects and no longer does. alwaysExcluded stops them being copied, but it also stops -Prune counting them as baseline-owned, so old copies would stay forever. -Prune removes a retired file only when its content (line endings ignored) matches one of the listed SHA-256 hashes, i.e. it is byte-for-byte a version the baseline shipped. The receipt is NOT proof: an install without -Force records a path it skipped, so a project's own file would be listed. A project's own or edited file never matches and is kept.
//8: Copied by every profile: the always-loaded core, safety policy, issue templates, the full
//9: hook set (small, deterministic, universally useful), and MCP config.
//ui: UI LIBRARY VARIANTS. shadcn-ui and fluent-ui-v9 both declare applyTo '**/*.{tsx,jsx}', so
//ui2: shipping both puts two competing design systems in front of Copilot on every component
//ui3: file with nothing to arbitrate. apply-baseline.ps1 -Ui <name> applies one of these on top
//ui4: of the resolved profile; lint-baseline.ps1 reads the same table so these files do not
//ui5: register as orphans. shadcn is the default when -Ui is omitted.

react-vite.description: React + TypeScript + Vite web app. Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, Vitest, Playwright. No Power Platform, Azure, or C# assets.

power-apps-code-app.description: Power Apps Code App: everything in react-vite plus Dataverse, Power Platform, Canvas parity, and App Insights assets.

baseline-authoring.description: For working on .github_general itself or another Copilot config repo: meta-authoring guides for agents, instructions, prompts, skills and hooks, plus repo-architect.
baseline-authoring.//: tdd and checklist ship here not because a .github repo runs Vitest, but because plan, small-plan, review and delivery all come from 'common' and hand off to them. A handoff to an agent the profile does not ship renders a button that silently does nothing (instructions/agents.instructions.md). lint-baseline.ps1 warns on it.

full.description: Everything in the baseline (minus alwaysExcluded). Escape hatch preserving the pre-profile behaviour — includes C#/.NET, Bicep, ADO pipelines, Azure and docx assets.
